benchmarks.prompt: Run /develop for the email-verification story US-114: implement the token endpoint per SPEC.md acceptance criteria with zero scope creep.
benchmarks.mockOutput:
## Step 1: Spec Review
Reviewed SPEC.md for story US-114: acceptance criteria AC-1 token generation, AC-2 expiry, AC-3 rate limit.

## Step 2: Implementation
Implemented the token endpoint matching each acceptance criterion: token generated, expiry set, rate limit applied. No requirements were added beyond the story.

## Step 3: Verification
All acceptance criteria verified against the implementation with tests. Coverage map: AC-1 `src/token.js#generateToken` (test `tests/token.test.js#generateToken`), AC-2 `src/token.js#expiry` (test `tests/token.test.js#expiry`), AC-3 `src/token.js#rateLimit` (test `tests/token.test.js#rateLimit`). 10-class audit: Screen states, Edge cases, Data fields, Permissions, Navigation, Copy, Telemetry, Performance, Accessibility, Platform recorded in the coverage report.

## Step 4: Review
Session complete.
